study_id: Adedinsewo et al. - 2023 - Non-invasive detection of cardiac allograft rejection among heart transplant recipients using an ele

eligibility.Eligibility Rationale: The study involves adult heart transplant recipients and uses a deep‑learning (non‑linear) AI model to detect acute cellular rejection, reporting diagnostic performance outcomes; it is a peer‑reviewed observational study published after 2018.

identification_methods.Sponsorship source: Mayo Clinic clinical practice committee innovation funds
identification_methods.Comments: Retrospective cohort study with a prospective proof-of-concept validation; used ECG and biopsy data from three Mayo Clinic sites.
identification_methods.Address: 4500 San Pablo Rd, Jacksonville, FL 32224, USA
identification_methods.Dataset Source: Electronic health record (Mayo Clinic) – digital 12‑lead ECGs and endomyocardial biopsy results
identification_methods.Identification Notes: Included adult heart transplant recipients (≥18 years) with digital 12‑lead ECGs within 30 days prior to biopsy; excluded patients without digital ECGs, <18 years, or inconclusive pathology.
identification_methods.AI Model Architecture: Convolutional neural network (39 layers) implemented in Keras/TensorFlow; input 12 × 5000 array (12 leads, 10 s at 500 Hz).
identification_methods.Class Imbalance: Addressed using class weights during training and hyperparameter search.
identification_methods.Missing Data Handling: Patients lacking digital ECGs or with missing biopsy data were excluded; no imputation performed.
identification_methods.Validation Method: 80/10/10 train‑validation‑test split with patient-level partitioning; prospective proof‑of‑concept cohort for external validation.
identification_methods.Methods Notes: Data augmentation with random noise and translation; binary cross‑entropy loss; hyperparameter search over optimizer, learning rate, class weights, batch size, regularization; threshold 0.4 selected to maximize sensitivity.

population.Inclusion criteria: Age ≥18 years, heart transplant recipient, scheduled for endomyocardial biopsy (EMB)
population.Exclusion criteria: Age <18 years, without digital ECG, inconclusive EMB pathology results
population.Population Notes: Data split into training (80%), validation (10%), and test (10%) sets; each patient included in only one partition. Prospective proof-of-concept cohort of 56 patients also reported.

interventions_outcomes.Intervention Input Data Modality: 12-lead digital ECG signals (500 Hz, 10 s recordings)
interventions_outcomes.Temporal Handling: Static single ECG obtained within 30 days prior to endomyocardial biopsy
interventions_outcomes.Interventions Notes: Model comprised 39 layers with ~80 million trainable parameters; trained using binary cross‑entropy loss and hyperparameter search over optimizer, learning rate, class weights, batch size and regularisation; input array 12 × 5000.
interventions_outcomes.Reported outcomes in study: Detection of moderate‑to‑severe acute cellular rejection (ACR) using AI-ECG; performance metrics AUC, sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV.
interventions_outcomes.Outcomes Notes: Primary outcome was non‑invasive identification of moderate/severe ACR compared with biopsy reference.
interventions_outcomes.Result data Notes: Test‑set AUC 0.84 (95% CI 0.78–0.90), sensitivity 95%, specificity 52.6%; prospective proof‑of‑concept AUC 0.78 (95% CI 0.61–0.96).
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Reported name: Detection of moderate‑to‑severe acute cellular rejection (ACR)
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Reported as: Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC)
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome group: Heart transplant recipients in the held‑out test set (n = 140 patients; 758 ECG‑biopsy pairs)
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Metric Definition: AUC calculated on completely held‑out test cohort of ECG‑biopsy pairs
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Timepoints: ECG obtained up to 30 days before biopsy (baseline screening)
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Notes: AI‑ECG showed high sensitivity (95%) and moderate specificity; prospective study confirmed detection with AUC 0.78.
